regime_context: The detector shows a two-tier US structure: a genuinely narrow rotational bid centered on Energy (eligible, mixed durability, not crowded, breadths 0.57–0.68) and a broad, heavily-crowded defensive/healthcare complex (Big Pharma, Health Care EW, Defensives, Staples all crowded, high durability, trend-structured) that dominates the top of the ranks despite Energy being the headline. The backtest verdict confirms the only validated edge is the absolute-trend drawdown gate; relative momentum is a focus lens, rotation timing is display-only, and this market's track record shows a weak directional accuracy (0.418) that calls for modest conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the crowded, high-durability defensive complex (Big Pharma/Health Care EW/Staples) loses its absolute-trend eligibility OR breadth rolls over from the 0.77–0.82 zone while Energy breadth holds above 0.6 — that combination (defensives fade from eligible while energy holds) would retire the current two-tier read and suggest a cleaner single-narrative energy regime.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the only top-5 theme that is both absolute-trend eligible AND not crowded, with the strongest breadth (0.682) among energy proxies and a mixed (not mean-reverting) structure. The detector's headline energy_complex leg shows confirming but not extreme momentum; the absolute-trend gate is the one validated drawdown-control edge and it is active here. The lean rests on trend-gate eligibility + breadth, not on the rank score.
evidence: headline US Energy Complex: durability_bar 0.6 (eligible), breadth 0.682, crowded false, val_state confirming
Energy (Equal-Weight): eligible true, breadth 0.571, crowded false, durability 0.6
theses.dissent: Energy is rank 2–3, not the leader, and its mixed Hurst tag suggests the trend is not clean; a vol spike or crude reversal could hit XLE hard, and gate_helps being true only promises shallower drawdowns, not positive return.

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by more than 3% total on the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the rotation leader and ranks #1, but it is NOT absolute-trend eligible (durability_bar 0.28, breadth 0.0) and its proxy SMH is also the proxy for several deeply negative AI/semi themes (AI Semiconductors, AI Infrastructure, Semicap Equipment all ineligible with negative or near-zero scores). The detector's only validated edge is the trend gate, and that gate says no participation here. Rank leadership is a focus lens, not a buy signal.
evidence: ranks Memory, HBM & Storage: eligible false, durability_bar 0.28, breadth 0.0, score 2.198
SMH is etf_proxy for memory_storage, ai_infra (-0.327, ineligible), ai_semiconductors (-0.76, ineligible), semicap_equipment (-0.473, ineligible)
theses.dissent: The #1 rank and trend-tag Hurst could mean the theme is genuinely leading and the low durability_bar is a lagging artifact; avoiding it could forfeit the strongest momentum in the market if the gate re-engages.

falsifier.text: Memory/HBM becomes absolute-trend eligible (durability_bar clears 0.6) AND SMH outperforms XLE into the 20-day check

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma and its close defensive cousins (Health Care EW, Defensives, Staples, Materials, Insurance) form a heavily-crowded, high-durability, trend-structured defensive complex at the top of the eligible ranks. Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade or sell — but here the breadth is high (0.778–0.817) and the crowding flags (z 1.19–1.74) justify an underweight lean as a de-risk call within the trend-gate discipline, not a contrarian short. The lean names the crowding leg as a caution on a fully-priced, one-directional crowded defensive leadership.
evidence: Big Pharma: eligible true, crowded true, crowding_z 1.56, durability 0.77, breadth 0.778
theses.dissent: Crowded can stay crowded longer than expected, and this defensive complex is the only broad, trend-eligible pocket with high breadth; an underweight reduces exposure to precisely where the validated trend-gate edge would have you stay.

falsifier.text: PPH and XLV both make new 60-day highs relative to XLE before the 20-day check-by

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
